notes:
Account profile: mid-sized e-discovery provider focused on government and regulated enterprise customers. Primary ask: scalable embeddings + reranking pipeline inside customer VPC with strict retention and audit logging.

Key technical constraints / requirements: 
- Index scale: currently ~25M unique documents, expecting 3-4x growth over 12 months (target architecture must handle up to 100M vectors).
- Embedding cadence: nightly bulk re-embed + incremental near-real-time updates for litigation uploads (minutes).
- Reranking strategy: bi-encoder candidate retrieval (ANN) + cross-encoder reranker on top-K=50-200; want to offload cross-encoder to dedicated GPU pool in Private deployment.
- Latency SLOs: baseline retrieval latency <80ms, end-to-end (retrieve+rerank) p95 <500ms for standard queries; for urgent e-discovery queries allow higher p95 up to 1.2s.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost-per-query (avg) <$0.02, with budget spike allowance for heavy legal review windows (up to 3x). Want clear per-token and per-rerank CPU/GPU cost breakdown.
- Storage / residency: EU and NA data residency options; retention controls with searchable retention labels (7 years default for legal hold).
- Auditability: immutable audit logs, tamper-evident retention, exportable audit trails, integration with their SIEM via syslog/forwarder.
- Keys / encryption: KMS integration required, preference for customer-managed key (HSM) for Private.
- Compliance: SOC2 required; ISO27001 preferred.
- Integrations: existing vector store experiments with Milvus + custom FAISS; evaluating Redwood for unified runtime + ops.

Conversation highlights / quotes: 
- "We need the reranker to live in our VPC — no exceptions for e-discovery cases." — Head of Security.
- "If you can show consistent p95 retrieval <500ms at 50 qps with 50M index, we're in." — CTO.

POC objectives (agreed): 
- Deploy Private control plane in customer VPC with dedicated GPU pool for cross-encoder reranks.
- Ingest a 10M doc sample, run nightly bulk embed + incremental ingestion flow.
- Demonstrate end-to-end p95 and cost metrics, enable audit log streaming to their SIEM, validate KMS/HSM operations.

- SE (Sofia) to share POC runbook and resource estimate by 2026-03-08.
- Customer to confirm procurement window and legal hold retention SLA target by 2026-03-18.
